candidates.change_summary: Insert 'owner = msg.sender;' at the start of NETM to allow any caller to become owner, changing balances mapping because the initial balance assignment will go to the new owner instead of the original.
Replace 'owner = msg.sender;' with 'owner = address(0);' so that the initial balance is assigned to address(0) instead of the deployer.
Replace 'balances[owner] = totalDistributed;' with 'balances[msg.sender] = totalDistributed;' so tokens are given to the caller, not the owner variable.
Delete the balance assignment 'balances[owner] = totalDistributed;' so no initial distribution occurs and balances mapping remains empty.
Replace 'require(msg.sender == owner);' with 'require(true);' to allow any caller to pass the onlyOwner check, enabling non-owner to call NETM and change balances.
Replace 'require(msg.sender == owner);' with 'require(msg.sender != owner);' so only non-owners can call owner-restricted functions like NETM.
Delete the require statement in onlyOwner, making the modifier pass for everyone and allowing any caller to execute NETM and change balances.
Move 'balances[owner] = totalDistributed;' before 'owner = msg.sender;' so that tokens are assigned to the previous owner address (initially address(0)) instead of the caller.
